about: Well-known sayings and who said them, for the Who Said It? mode. KJV wording (public domain). Written for this app; scripts/import-bible-mcq.mjs turns each into a multiple-choice question, taking the wrong options from other speakers in the same Testament. Rows: [book, chapter, verse, quote, speaker].
